judge.rationale: The candidate never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, meaning the bug remains completely unfixed and the newly added test will fail. Furthermore, the candidate omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update entirely and left behind an internal `.lore/dod.md` planning artifact. In `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md`, the candidate updated the line in the 'Measured semantics — out of scope' section (which explicitly states 'This issue changes none of them') rather than moving the new guarantee into the main specification section as the reference did. Finally, instead of adding the test to `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, the candidate created a separate acceptance test file that does not verify the relative execution order of `onError` and `afterSession`.
